question: Should the maintainers accept this broad internal consolidation of subagent delivery evidence after a current-main merge-result review, or narrow it into smaller owner-scoped changes?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and the refactor's cross-cutting effect on delivery suppression and retry behavior require explicit owner judgment beyond an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Refresh and land as one refactor
options.body: Rebase onto current `main` and land after maintainers confirm the shared evidence contract preserves all announcement and restart-recovery behavior.

options.title: Split by ownership boundary
options.body: Keep message visibility, origin routing, and announce-delivery changes as smaller PRs if the unified review remains difficult to validate.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land as one refactor
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main` and land after maintainers confirm the shared evidence contract preserves all announcement and restart-recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current cross-cutting agent-delivery refactor and is the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied evidence.
